dogecoin.text:
Grayscale launches Dogecoin Trust; Franklin Templeton debuts Crypto ETF.

Stablecoin volume to hit $300B by year-end; new U.S. bill proposed.

AI drives crypto growth with ChatGPT-5 and Nvidia’s GTCAI on horizon.

Bitcoin hashrate reaches 1,000 EH/s; Solana meme coins lose $15B

Grayscale has filed for a spot Cardano $ADA ETF with the NYSE, and the SEC is reviewing a spot Dogecoin ETF filing. Elsewhere, $LINK price may see a rebound due to emerging catalysts, while memecoins like BANANAS31 and $ANDY have surged triple digits.
